name: How long does it take to install a low threshold walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a low threshold walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most low threshold shower installations take between one and two weeks to complete. The exact timeline depends on the project scope, such as whether you are replacing an existing shower or converting an old bathtub. Converting a tub requires demolition, rough plumbing adjustments, and subfloor inspection. Following that, custom wall framing, moisture barriers, shower pan setting, tile installation, and fixture trim-out take place. Coordinating licensed plumbing trades alongside tile curing times also affects the final schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A low threshold shower installation generally takes about one to two weeks, depending on whether it involves a tub conversion, plumbing changes, and tile work.
